archetype: Luxury (Archetype 5) + Swiss High-Contrast (Archetype 4) - Dark Navy/Purple/Blue Luxury Styling

headings.strategy: Expressive, tight tracking for high-end feel. No generic Inter for headings.

body.strategy: Crisp, highly legible for dense admin data and tables.

colors.strategy: Deep midnight blue/navy background (#090E17) with royal purple/indigo primary actions (#4F46E5). High contrast text for dense data. Avoid #7351B7 and #1B93A4. Strict adherence to luxury e-commerce admin aesthetics.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky headers (bg-[#090E17]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Flat solid for dashboard widgets with max 8px border-radius.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10. Subtle and sharp. No soft UI.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient glow for active elements (e.g., shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(79,70,229,0.2)]). Do not use heavy drop shadows on cards.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B). Dense data correlation, scanability.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous container padding (p-6, p-8) but tight grid gaps (gap-4, gap-6) for widgets.
grids_and_layouts.structure: Persistent sidebar navigation (left), sticky top header (glassmorphism), main content area.

components.buttons: Max 8px radius. Hover states must explicitly shift to a lighter hue of the primary color (e.g., hover:bg-indigo-500 hover:text-white). Ensure future-proof modularity.
components.cards: Subtle roundness (8px), border border-white/10, solid dark background (#121A2F). No drop shadows, use borders for definition.
components.forms_inputs: Shadcn standard inputs. Custom border colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500. Background #1A243D.
components.tables: Dense layouts. IBM Plex Sans for tabular data (perfect for wallet ledger and product lists). Clear row hover states (hover:bg-white/5).
components.toasts: Sonner for all notifications (e.g., one-click update success).
components.dialogs: Used for quick-add actions, product image previews, and coupon setup.

icons.strategy: Regular or Duotone weight. Consistent sizing (20px).

motion.strategy: Minimalist micro-interactions. Hover states for all interactive elements. Enter animations for data tables (staggered).
motion.rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Never apply 'transition: all'. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors duration-200).

accessibility.contrast: APCA preferred. Normal text min 4.5:1. Interactive elements min 3:1.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on inputs and buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='product-publish-button', data-testid='wallet-credit-btn').

images.description: Black box with gold lettering for luxury product placeholders
Chanel bag with perfume for product mockups
Portrait of a young middle eastern man for admin or customer avatar
Dark teal wavy shapes on black for login or banner backgrounds

media.image_rules: Never use placeholders. Preserve main subjects. Images over content should use gradient overlays (max bg-black/50).

specific_features.product_management: CRUD table with multiple image upload zones. Image previews are mandatory. Provide a 'one-click publish' toggle with instant state update and toast feedback.
specific_features.wallet_ledger: Credit/Debit UI requires high contrast tabular data showing green text for credit (+), red for debit (-). Keep numbers monospaced.
specific_features.content_publishing: Homepage content publishing, banner, campaign, coupon control. Utilize modular forms and sections.
specific_features.users_and_orders: Dashboards for Users, Vendors, Orders, Payments, and Auctions. Display KPIs using high-density grid metrics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Shadcn components customized with the dark navy/purple/blue luxury theme.
Build the dashboard layout with a fixed sidebar and sticky header.
Implement product CRUD with drag-and-drop multiple image upload previews.
Ensure the wallet debit/credit ledger is visually distinct and heavily utilizes IBM Plex Sans for monospaced figures.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, links, and actionable icons.
Use sonner for success/error toasts after any one-click update operations.
Avoid fully transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns. ALWAYS use solid or heavy backdrop-blur backgrounds.
Never center-align the app container globally. Maintain a robust structural alignment.
Ensure all buttons are 'future-ready' (extensible UI components).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not apply universal 'transition: all'. Apply transitions strictly to interactive elements excluding transforms.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical for luxurious feel.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡).
Use sonner for toasts, locate it in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Always use the provided image URLs. NEVER fall back to via.placeholder.com or similar dummy services.
